intro.fr: Piranesi Restoration Project, jeu du moteur libre Luanti, se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un mod client.
intro.en: Piranesi Restoration Project, a game for the open-source Luanti engine, can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a client mod.

text.fr: Warr1024 publie sur ContentDB Archipelago for Piranesi, qui relie le jeu à un serveur Archipelago ; la plus ancienne version listée date de novembre 2025, la plus récente de juin 2026.
text.en: Warr1024 publishes Archipelago for Piranesi on ContentDB, which connects the game to an Archipelago server; the oldest listed release dates from November 2025, the latest from June 2026.
